country: Al Jumhuriyah al Jaza'iriyah ad Dimuqratiyah ash Sha'biyah

fields.climate: arid to semiarid; mild, wet winters with hot, dry summers along coast; drier with cold winters and hot summers on high plateau; sirocco is a hot, dust/sand-laden wind especially common in summer
fields.terrain: mostly high plateau and desert; Atlas Mountains in the far north and Hoggar Mountains in the south; narrow, discontinuous coastal plain
fields.hazards: mountainous areas subject to severe earthquakes; mudslides and floods in rainy season; droughts
fields.resources: petroleum, natural gas, iron ore, phosphates, uranium, lead, zinc
fields.farm: potatoes, watermelons, wheat, milk, onions, tomatoes, vegetables, oranges, dates, barley
fields.exports: natural gas, crude petroleum, refined petroleum, fertilizers, iron bars
fields.industries: petroleum, natural gas, light industries, mining, electrical, petrochemical, food processing
fields.languages: Arabic (official), French (lingua franca), Tamazight (official) (dialects include Kabyle (Taqbaylit), Shawiya (Tacawit), Mzab, Tuareg (Tamahaq))
fields.religions: Muslim (official; predominantly Sunni) 99%, other (includes Christian, Jewish, Ahmadi Muslim, Shia Muslim, Ibadi Muslim) <1%
fields.legal: mixed system of French civil law and Islamic law; judicial review of legislative acts in ad hoc Constitutional Council composed of various public officials including several Supreme Court justices
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; 19 years of age for mandatory national service for men (all Algerian men must register at age 17)…
